plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Program page states the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027 and the map is headed 'Theatre Arts map for 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. This plan transcribes the program's only pathway, 'Theatre Arts to CSU', in full; it is a Bakersfield College-only map with no second-institution section (the pathway diagram names no continuation institution, degree, units or terms). The transcribed map prints the degree total as a range, 60-68 units, and term totals as 14-15.5 / 16-18.5 / 15-18 / 15-16. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Area 1B : Critical Thinking and Composition' (3-4) and 'Area 2 : Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning' (3-4.5); Term 3 'Theatre Laboratory' (1-2), 'Area 3B : Humanities' (3-4) and 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' (3-4); Term 4 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' (3-4). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. THEA B20 is printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed'; it is a named major course and is recorded with category 'major'. Term 2 prints two separate 'CSU Transferable Elective' rows (3 units and 2 units); both are recorded as separate choice slots exactly as printed. No row shows a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View, so no prereqs are recorded. General-education, major-list, theatre-laboratory and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. This map's disclaimer wording differs from the other Bakersfield maps collected this wave and is recorded verbatim. The map page states verbatim: 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.' The map also prints the footnote: 'Ready for the next step? Make an appointment with an advisor to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.'
